correctness.rationale: Exact Robin/reflection ODE and renewal derive T. value.rationale: Exact, motivated all-rate policy boundary for a finite reflecting search domain with a partially reactive target. It proves the local reset-benefit sign is equivalent to global benefit and that the zero-reset optimum is uniquely strict, determines reaction-limited threshold motion, and rules out disconnected gains where the coefficient positivity applies. No uniqueness of positive-rate optimum claimed.
